I was diagnosed with two lifelong conditions, and thanks to Dr. Moukli’s persistence, professionalism, and genuinely caring attitude, I got an appointment with Gastro in no time at all. This doctor actually listens and goes above and beyond. Something that’s becoming rare these days.

Now, I’ve seen some of the 1star reviews floating around here, and I have to laugh. Some people just don’t like hearing facts from trained medical professionals with years of training, rather than from “Dr. Google.” If you’re after validation for your WebMD diagnosis, maybe the NHS isn’t the problem…

The telephone appointments make perfect sense. Efficient, convenient, and if you need to be seen face2face, it usually happens the same day. And here’s a thought, if you miss your phone call twice, that’s not the doctor’s fault. They can’t spend the day rearranging their schedule around yours.

People really don’t realise how lucky they are to have this team. Some surgeries have three doctors for 15,000 patients. This one has at least two a day for around 4000patients. I’ve never once had an issue getting an appointment, same day or next day, and I’ve never been stuck in some endless queue.

Everyone I’ve spoken to, from reception to nurses to doctors, has always been polite, professional and patient. Even when dealing with the… let’s just say less than reasonable. People really need to start taking responsibility for their own health. Show up to your appointments, answer your phone, chase up your own results and give these guys a break. They’re doing their best and it really shows.

In short: Fantastic surgery, fantastic doctors, fantastic care.
